Google does not officially state TPUv7's TDP. In the blog post announcing TPUv7 (https://blog.google/products/google-cloud/ironwood-tpu-age-of-inference/ ), Google disclosed that TPUv7 is 29.3x more efficient than the TPUv2 in peak FLOP/s per TDP (measuring peak FLOP/s as either FP8 or bf16 FLOP/s when FP8 is not supported). 

TPUv2 does 46 TFLOP/s peak and has a TDP of 280 W. 

TPUv7 does 4614 TFLOP/s peak (FP8). So the TPUv7's TDP is (4614 TFLOP/s / 46 TFLOP/s) * 280 W / 29.3x efficiency = ~959 W. Note that this may be a slightly approximate figure due to rounding on Google's part. We round to 960 W.
